# Every engine call a stdlib dispatcher makes on its stdlib routes, classified.
# Generated by tools/codemap/predispatch_enum.py from the code (libclang), compared
# by tests/self-audit/test_predispatch_enumeration.sh: a call the code makes that
# is not listed here FAILS the test until it is classified, and a row the code no
# longer makes fails it too, so this list cannot outlive the code (roadmap item 6).
#
# Check rows -- dispatcher <TAB> method <TAB> guard (module/method literals, * =
# every call) <TAB> class <TAB> why:
#   gate       refuses by policy for every call it guards; modelled as [predispatch]
#   detector   refuses only when more than the call's name holds; [precheck] context
#   post-call  runs after the call returns (taint marking, the BSD record)
#   context    state a check reads, or a value it is handed; refuses nothing itself
#
# Route rows -- route <TAB> dispatcher <TAB> sink <TAB> guard <TAB> count <TAB>
# what runs <TAB> which routes: each call that RUNS a stdlib function under a
# stdlib-marker guard, searched backward from the sink, so a route with no check
# at all is listed. Two routes with the same guard are one row with count 2. A
# dispatcher's checks are listed per dispatcher, not per route; the route rows
# say which route runs which (the per-route table in CLAUDE.md, "Pre-dispatch
# checks").
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::checkDangerousCall	*	detector	inert for NAAb names: no DANGEROUS_PATTERNS_DB pattern is language naab, and its one `any` pattern cannot match a dotted name
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::checkFileOpsRate	file	detector	limits.rate file operations per second
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::checkFilesystemAllowed	*	gate	capabilities.filesystem.mode, for what filesystemAccessMode classifies ([predispatch] via the allowlist)
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::checkNetworkAllowed	http	gate	capabilities.network, every http call ([predispatch] module gate)
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::checkPathAccess	*	gate	allowed_paths / blocked_paths on the first argument
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::checkPathAccess	copy,move	gate	the same, on the copy/move destination
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::checkStdlibRate	*	detector	limits.rate stdlib calls per second
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::copyMoveDestination	copy,move	context	resolves a directory destination to the file the OS lands on
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::filesystemAccessMode	*	context	the allowlist: which calls the filesystem gate judges, and as read or write
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::isActive	*	context	mode off skips every check
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::isActive	codegen,run,run_strict,run_with_args	context	mode off skips the codegen taint plumbing
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::isSanitizer	*	post-call	clears the return value's taint
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::isTaintSource	*	post-call	marks the return value tainted
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	GovernanceEngine::setLastReturnTainted	*	post-call	hands the return's taint to the assignment
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	Interpreter::checkExpressionTaintedSink	*	detector	a tainted argument reaching a sink (every argument of every call)
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	Interpreter::checkExpressionTaintedSink	append,write	detector	the same, file.write/append content
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	Interpreter::checkExpressionTaintedSink	delete_var,env	detector	the same, env.delete_var
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	Interpreter::checkExpressionTaintedSink	env,set_var	detector	the same, env.set_var's value
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	Interpreter::checkExpressionTaintedSink	http	detector	the same, an http URL (SSRF)
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	Interpreter::checkRhsTainted	*	post-call	propagates an argument's taint to the return value
Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	stdlib::setCodegenArgTainted	codegen,run,run_strict,run_with_args	context	hands codegen.run the code argument's taint (codegen enforces it)
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::checkDangerousCall	*	detector	inert for NAAb names; checks `<module>.call` for a module called as a function
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::checkFilesystemAllowed	file	gate	`file(...)` (the module called as a function), judged as a write; callBuiltinFunction has no builtin named file, so the call it guards only errors (observed)
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::checkNetworkAllowed	http	gate	`http(...)`, the same shape; the call it guards only errors (observed: Unknown built-in function)
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::checkTaintedValueAtSink	*	detector	a tainted argument to a module called as a function
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::checkTaintedValueAtSink	print,println	detector	a tainted argument to print/println (the print sink)
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::isActive	*	context	mode off skips every check
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::isActive	file	context	mode off skips the file gate
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::isActive	http	context	mode off skips the network gate
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::isActive	print,println	context	mode off skips the print sink check
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::isSanitizer	*	post-call	clears the return value's taint
VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	GovernanceEngine::isTaintSource	*	post-call	marks the return value tainted
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkDangerousCall	*	detector	inert for NAAb names (see the tree-walker row)
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkDangerousCall	env	detector	inert, the env-specific call (Finding E): the same empty pattern set
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkFileOpsRate	file	detector	limits.rate file operations per second (VM::callStdlibMethod, every route)
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkFilesystemAllowed	*	gate	capabilities.filesystem.mode, method-call route only
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkNetworkAllowed	http	gate	capabilities.network, method-call route only
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkPathAccess	*	gate	allowed_paths / blocked_paths on the first argument
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkPathAccess	copy,move	gate	the same, on the copy/move destination
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkPreExecution	*	detector	behavioural sequence pre-check (vm.cpp bsdPreCheck; VM only, B11)
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkStdlibRate	*	detector	limits.rate stdlib calls per second (VM::callStdlibMethod, every route)
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::checkTaintedValueAtSink	*	detector	a tainted argument reaching a sink (taint_stack_)
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::copyMoveDestination	copy,move	context	resolves a directory destination to the file the OS lands on
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::emitEvent	*	post-call	the BSD record of the call (vm.cpp bsdRecord)
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::endPreExecutionScope	*	post-call	ends the pre-check's "already recorded" mark (A50)
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::filesystemAccessMode	*	context	the allowlist: which calls the filesystem gate judges, and as read or write
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::functionAttributionEnabled	*	context	whether to sync the attribution stack
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::getRules	*	context	reads taint lineage / BSD switches
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::isActive	*	context	mode off skips every check
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::isActive	copy,move	context	mode off skips the destination check
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::isActive	env	context	mode off skips the env dangerous-call check
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::isActive	http	context	mode off skips the network gate
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::isSanitizer	*	post-call	clears the return value's taint
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::isTaintSource	*	post-call	marks the return value tainted
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::lastReturnWasTainted	*	post-call	propagates a tainted return
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::setLastReturnTainted	*	post-call	records the return's taint
VM::run()	GovernanceEngine::syncFunctionStack	*	context	function attribution the checks INSIDE the call read (capabilities.functions)
VM::run()	stdlib::setCodegenArgTainted	codegen,run,run_strict,run_with_args	context	hands codegen.run the code argument's taint (codegen enforces it)
route	Interpreter::visit(CallExpr&)	Module::call	__stdlib_call__	1	gated	the tree-walker's one stdlib call route (call_dispatch.cpp, `__stdlib_call__:` from the member route): filesystem mode and path (and the copy/move destination), network on http, dangerous call, argument taint, both rate limits; no BSD (B11)
route	Interpreter::visit(MemberExpr&)	Module::call	__stdlib_module__,math	1	nothing to gate	math constants only (`math.PI`, `E`, `pi`, `e`), evaluated on member access
route	VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	VM::callBuiltinFunction	__builtin__	1	taint only	a builtin called as a function (`print(x)`, `len(x)`): the print/println taint sink check, taint source/sanitizer after; a builtin is not a stdlib module, so no module gate
route	VM::callValue(NaabVal, int)	VM::callBuiltinFunction	__stdlib_module__	1	gated	a stdlib module called as a function (`string(42)`): filesystem write gate for file, network gate for http, dangerous call, argument taint; runs callBuiltinFunction(module name), which knows only string/int/float/bool-style builtins
route	VM::run()	VM::callStdlibMethod	__builtin__	2	ungated, string only	OP_CALL_METHOD and OP_GET_MEMBER on a `__builtin__:` marker naming a stdlib module (`StdLib::hasModule`), with and without arguments: rate limits inside callStdlibMethod and taint source/sanitizer after, nothing else. The one name that is both a builtin and a stdlib module is `string` (vm.cpp's builtins list against the module list, traced), which no gate classifies; a new builtin that names a gated module would reach its functions here ungated
route	VM::run()	VM::callStdlibMethod	__stdlib_module__	2	gated	OP_CALL_METHOD (`module.fn(args)`) and OP_GET_MEMBER's zero-argument call (`module.fn` without parentheses): both run VM::stdlibCallGates (filesystem mode and path, copy/move destination, network on http, dangerous call), function attribution, the BSD pre-check and record, and callStdlibMethod's rate limits; argument taint and the codegen plumbing on the first only, the second having no arguments
